pattern.description: Centered two-line question builds word by word in sync with narration: each new word fades in light grey and darkens to near-black while the centered lines re-center and wrap as words are added.
pattern.why_premium: Word-paced reveal locks the text to the voice, and the grey-to-black settle gives each word a soft landing instead of a hard pop; the live re-centering keeps the composition balanced at every frame.

build_hint.gsap: Split headline into words; tl.fromTo(words, {opacity: 0, color: '#9a9a9a'}, {opacity: 1, color: '#111', duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.17}); animate the line container's x/y with Flip (or a short power2.inOut tween) so the centered block re-centers as each word lands.
build_hint.remotion: Per word i: start = i*5 frames at 30fps; opacity = interpolate(frame-start, [0, 4], [0, 1]); color = interpolateColors(frame-start, [0, 9], ['#9a9a9a', '#111']); recompute centered layout from visible words and smooth its offset with spring({damping: 200}) (no overshoot).

notes: Word order of reveal: Can't, find, what, you're, looking, for?. Earlier words drift slightly as the centered layout reflows (camera.move none; scale 1.03 reflects reflow, not a camera move). No SFX candidates.
